Render FPS is reciprocal of observed main-window frame intervals during each phase; short phases can have too few frames to compare. Process GPU busy is PDH busiest matching PID+adapter engine; local VRAM is per-process DXGI WDDM usage. Counters sampled at 2Hz can miss short peaks. Memory endpoints/ranges do not establish leak freedom.
